items.question: In the UAE, must an applicant for high school certificate equalisation be a UAE resident?
items.gold: Yes, the applicant must be a UAE resident.
items.fact: Equalisation applicants must be UAE residents, per general conditions

items.question: Which grades of high school certificates must an applicant submit as originals when applying for high school certificate equalisation in the UAE?
items.gold: Mainly grades 10, 11 and 12, which are returned after verification.
items.fact: Original certificates mainly grades 10, 11, 12 required for equalisation
